## Name And Purpose

What does this help someone build or do?

## Author And Permission

Who made it? Are you the author or do you have permission to redistribute it?
What licence applies? Include the licence text or a link to it.

## Files Or Source

Link to the exact package version, source repository or original discussion.
If you need help handing over the files, say so. Do not post private links,
credentials or assets you do not have permission to redistribute.

## Compatibility And Tests

- Unity version(s) actually tested:
- Creator SDK version(s) actually tested:
- Banter SDK version(s) actually tested:
- Dependencies:
- Editor/headset/multiplayer test results (write untested where applicable):

## Contents And Instructions

Describe setup/removal steps and whether it contains C#, Editor scripts,
executables, network access or changes to existing project files.
Add an optional screenshot with private information removed.

## Limitations

Known issues, restrictions, or anything reviewers should check.

This is a proposal. Submission does not automatically publish or run the files.
